title: Hotline toolbar layout and shortcuts (v3)
description: Toolbar rows, style, overrides, custom buttons and panel shortcuts in toolbar.json (unit: JSON object).

shortcuts.description: In-panel keyboard shortcuts keyed by command id; empty string disables (unit: hotkey map).

stop.description: Stop streaming answer shortcut; bare keys allowed (unit: hotkey string).

newChat.description: Start a new chat shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

recent.description: Open recent chats list shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

settings.description: Open settings window shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

pin.description: Toggle panel pin shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

copyLastAnswer.description: Copy last completed answer shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

captureRegion.description: Capture screen region shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

prompt.description: Open prompt picker shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

effort.description: Cycle effort picker shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

model.description: Cycle model picker shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

provider.description: Cycle provider picker shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

captureWindow.description: Capture foreground window shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

continueIn.description: Open Continue this chat in menu shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

more.description: Open overflow/more menu shortcut (unit: hotkey string).

top.description: Top toolbar row above the message box (unit: row object).

left.description: Item ids in the top-left group (unit: id array).

center.description: Item ids in the top-center group (unit: id array).

right.description: Item ids in the top-right group (unit: id array).

bottom.description: Bottom toolbar row below the message box (unit: row object).

left.description: Item ids in the bottom-left group (unit: id array).

center.description: Item ids in the bottom-center group (unit: id array).

right.description: Item ids in the bottom-right group (unit: id array).

menu.description: Button ids placed in the 'more' button menu instead of on the bar (unit: id array).

style.description: Bar-wide visual style defaults (unit: style object).

width.description: Button width share in grid cells (unit: cells).

fill.description: Share spare row room proportionally among items (unit: boolean).

outline.description: Draw a 1.5 DIP outline border around items (unit: boolean).

filled.description: Draw a filled background on items (unit: boolean).

outlineColor.description: Outline hex colour '#RRGGBB'; null uses accent colour (unit: hex colour).

overrides.description: Per-item style or picker span overrides keyed by item id (unit: override map).

buttons.description: Custom button definitions keyed by 1-32 ASCII letters (either case), digits or hyphens; ids match without case, first definition wins, built-ins and stop/spacer are reserved (unit: button map).

width.description: Button width override in grid cells; buttons only (unit: cells).

span.description: Picker width share in grid cells; pickers only (unit: cells).

outlineColor.description: Item outline hex colour '#RRGGBB' (unit: hex colour).

icon.description: Segoe Fluent Icons glyph codepoint E000-F8FF (unit: hex codepoint).

iconFile.description: Custom PNG filename in icons\ matching '<id>.png' without regard to id or extension case (unit: filename).

quickAction.description: Quick action name in actions\ (unit: action name).

text.description: Message text inserted when clicked (unit: string).

shortcut.description: Optional in-panel keyboard shortcut combo (unit: hotkey string).
